title: The Engine Sings Wrong: Hidden Law
description: The Engine Sings Wrong unfolds across broken heaven-engine platforms with rotating halo mechanisms, pushing a 5-Titan Empyrean squad to prove protection, order-locks, shields, anti-chaos control, formationless aura play. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: The Engine Sings Wrong: Hidden Law advances Empyrean Choir Vault: The Radiant Hierarchies ascend a broken heaven-engine where order can stabilize worlds or erase dissonant survivors. It directly tests the faction tension: Their mercy is real, but so is their judgment. Allies fear becoming evidence in an Empyrean trial.
